stage: S2 certificate request creation for later account/enrollment chain
actualProductionChange: The existing single material Vault creates PKCS10 from namespace/keyID/expectedGeneration, reopens its exact permanent Keychain tag, checks ready state/RSA2048/public hash, then signs exact DER request-info and verifies the signature with the public key.

The request includes UTF8 CN, supported bounded ASCII email, RSA PKCS1 public key inside SPKI, version0 and required empty attributes; SHA256-with-RSA algorithm uses explicit NULL. Only public key bytes are exported. Subjects/private data are not logged or persisted by this read/sign operation.

Cancellation and observed manifest equality are checked before signing and before returning. CSR carries namespace/keyID/generation/public hash and public DER only; later certificate/profile publication still requires the existing validation and CAS.

CertificateRequestFailure is separate from existing15 Vault.Failure cases. The former v2 shared-enum extension would leave AppSession exhaustive switch incomplete; root caught it before integration, v3 fixes the source, and independent addendum corrects the earlier review.

definedCases: Real persisted-key reopen, DER parsing through existing parser, independent imported public-key signature verification and tampered request rejection; old publication/manifest preserved.
Stale generation, foreign namespace, revoked and actually deleted permanent keys reject requests.
Bounded invalid subject forms and observed cancellation retain existing manifest/generation.

primaryReferences.supports: PKCS10 exact signed request-info, SPKI and attribute/signature structure.
RSA algorithm identifiers, SHA256 signature and public key encoding.
Apple certificate requests use a common name and email subject.
RSA exported key representation is PKCS1.

limits: This is a CSR primitive in the real Vault, not an account authorization or remote certificate/profile refresh client. It is not yet called by a completed enrollment service.
Manifest equality detects observed changes; no cross-process lock, remote transaction, certificate issuance or Apple authorization is established.
Subject support is explicitly bounded, not a full DN/mail validator. Returned public CSR contains the supplied name/email.
New3 native definitions and both changed inputs are outside already submitted f51af09 current314/316 source tag. Its pending result cannot accept this later source.
